translations.literal: Prayer clerks with carrying-poles lifted the tripods in pairs; responsible officers bore ladles and followed, setting each out inside the food canopy.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer clerks with poles lifted the tripods in pairs; officers with ladles followed and set them inside the food canopy.

sentences.zh: 俟光祿卿出，帥其屬實籩豆簠簋訖，乃去鼎之扃冪，匕加於鼎。

translations.literal: They awaited the Director of Imperial Entertainments to come forth and lead his subordinates to fill the bian, dou, fu, and gui; when finished the tripod bars and covers were removed and ladles placed on the tripods.
translations.idiomatic: When the Director of Imperial Entertainments and his staff had filled the bian, dou, fu, and gui, the bars and covers came off the tripods and ladles were set on them.

sentences.zh: 大官令以匕升羊豕，各載於俎，俟初獻還位，樂止。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Kitchen with ladles lifted sheep and pig, each loading them onto zuo; they awaited the initial offerer's return to station; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The kitchen director ladled sheep and pig onto zuo and waited until the initial offerer returned to station; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引司徒出詣饌所，帥進饌者各奉正配位之饌，大官令引以次自西神門入。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the Minister of Education out to the food station, and those bringing food each bore the offerings for the principal and associated seats; the Director of the Imperial Kitchen led them in order through the western spirit gate.
translations.idiomatic: A ritual usher led the Minister of Education to the food station; food-bearers bore offerings for the principal and associated seats, and the kitchen director led them in through the western spirit gate.

sentences.zh: 正位之饌入自中門，配位之饌入自偏門。

translations.literal: Offerings for the principal seat entered by the central gate; offerings for the associated seat entered by the side gate.
translations.idiomatic: Principal offerings entered through the central gate, associated offerings through the side gate.

sentences.zh: 饌初入門，樂作，饌至陛，樂止。

translations.literal: When the food first entered the gate, music began; when the food reached the steps, the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the offerings first entered the gate music began; when they reached the steps the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 祝史俱進，徹毛血豆，降自西陛以出。

translations.literal: Prayer clerks all advanced, removed the hair-and-blood dou, and descended by the west steps to exit.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer clerks advanced, removed the hair-and-blood dou, and descended the west steps to exit.

sentences.zh: 正位之饌升自北陛，配位之饌升自西陛，諸太祝迎取於壇上，各跪奠於神座前訖，俯伏興。

translations.literal: Offerings for the principal seat ascended by the north steps, those for the associated seat by the west steps; grand invokers met and received them on the altar; each knelt and presented before the spirit seat; when finished they prostrated and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Principal offerings ascended the north steps and associated offerings the west steps; grand invokers met them on the altar, knelt and presented before each spirit seat, then prostrated and rose.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引司徒、大官令及進饌者，自西陛各復位。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the Minister of Education, the Director of the Imperial Kitchen, and those bringing food down by the west steps, each returning to his station.
translations.idiomatic: The usher led the Minister of Education, kitchen director, and food-bearers down the west steps; each returned to station.

sentences.zh: 諸太祝還尊所，贊者曰「太祝立茅苴於沙池」。

translations.literal: All grand invokers returned to the wine-vessel station; an announcer said, "Grand invokers, set the thatch in the sand pool."
translations.idiomatic: Grand invokers returned to the wine station; an announcer called, "Grand invokers, set the thatch in the sand pool."

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻官詣太社壇盥洗位，樂作，至位南向立，樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the initial offering official to the hand-washing station at the Great Altar of Soil; music began; when he reached his station he stood south-facing; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: A ritual usher led the initial offerer to the hand-washing station at the Soil altar; music began; at his station he stood facing south; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 搢笏，盥手，帨手，執笏詣爵洗位，至位南向立，搢笏，洗爵、拭爵，以爵授執事者，執笏詣壇，樂作，升自北陛，至壇上，樂止。

translations.literal: He inserted his tablet, washed his hands, dried them, took up his tablet, and proceeded to the cup-washing station; at his station he stood south-facing, inserted his tablet, washed the cup and dried it, and handed the cup to an attendant; he took up his tablet and proceeded to the altar; music began; he ascended by the north steps to the top of the altar; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He washed and dried his hands, went to the cup-washing station, washed and dried the cup and handed it to an attendant, then went to the altar; music began; he ascended the north steps to the top, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 詣太社酌尊所，東向立，執事者以爵授初獻，初獻搢笏執爵，司尊者舉冪，良醞令跪酌太尊之泛齊，樂作。

translations.literal: He proceeded to the libation station at the Great Altar of Soil and stood east-facing; an attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer; the initial offerer inserted his tablet and took the cup; the Keeper of Ritual Vessels raised the cover; the Director of Fine Brew knelt and poured fan qi from the Grand Vessel; music began.
translations.idiomatic: He came to the libation station at the Soil altar and stood facing east; an attendant handed him the cup; the vessel keeper raised the cover and the brewer knelt and poured fan qi from the Grand Vessel as music began.

sentences.zh: 初獻以爵授執事者，執笏詣太社神座前，南向立，搢笏跪。

translations.literal: The initial offerer handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, and proceeded before the spirit seat of the Great Altar of Soil; standing south-facing, he inserted his tablet and knelt.
translations.idiomatic: The initial offerer handed back the cup, went before the Soil altar's spirit seat, stood facing south, and knelt.

sentences.zh: 執事者以爵授初獻，初獻執爵三祭酒，奠爵，執笏俯伏興，少退立，樂止。

translations.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer; the initial offerer held the cup and poured libation three times, placed the cup, took up his tablet, prostrated, and rose, withdrew slightly and stood; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant handed him the cup; he poured libation three times, placed the cup, prostrated and rose, withdrew slightly, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 舉祝官跪，對舉祝版。

translations.literal: The prayer-holding official knelt and raised the prayer tablet facing him.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer-holding official knelt and raised the prayer tablet before him.

sentences.zh: 讀祝官西向跪，讀祝文。

translations.literal: The prayer-reading official knelt west-facing and read the prayer text.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer reader knelt facing west and read the prayer.

sentences.zh: 讀訖，俯伏興，舉祝官奠祝版於案，興。

translations.literal: When the reading was finished, he prostrated and rose; the prayer-holding official placed the prayer tablet on the desk and rose.
translations.idiomatic: When the reading was done he prostrated and rose; the prayer-holding official set the tablet on the desk and rose.

sentences.zh: 初獻再拜訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The initial offerer bowed twice; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The initial offerer bowed twice, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 次詣后土氏酌尊所，東向立。

translations.literal: Next he proceeded to the libation station of the Spirit of Earth and stood east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Next he came to the Spirit of Earth's libation station and stood facing east.

sentences.zh: 執事者以爵授初獻，初獻搢笏執爵，司尊彜舉冪，良醞令跪酌著尊之泛齊，樂作。

translations.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer; the initial offerer inserted his tablet and took the cup; the Keeper of Ritual Vessels raised the cover; the Director of Fine Brew knelt and poured fan qi from the Standing Vessel; music began.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant handed him the cup; the vessel keeper raised the cover and the brewer knelt and poured fan qi from the Standing Vessel as music began.

sentences.zh: 初獻以爵授執事者，執笏詣后土神座前，西向立，搢笏跪。

translations.literal: The initial offerer handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, and proceeded before the spirit seat of the Spirit of Earth; standing west-facing, he inserted his tablet and knelt.
translations.idiomatic: The initial offerer handed back the cup and went before the Spirit of Earth's seat, stood facing west, and knelt.

sentences.zh: 執事者以爵授初獻，初獻執爵三祭酒，奠爵訖，執笏俯伏興，少退立，樂止。

translations.literal: An attendant handed the cup to the initial offerer; the initial offerer held the cup and poured libation three times; when placement was finished he took up his tablet, prostrated, and rose, withdrew slightly and stood; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: An attendant handed him the cup; he poured libation three times, placed the cup, prostrated and rose, withdrew slightly, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 舉祝官跪，對舉祝版。

translations.literal: The prayer-holding official knelt and raised the prayer tablet facing him.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer-holding official knelt and raised the prayer tablet before him.

sentences.zh: 讀祝官南向跪，讀祝文。

translations.literal: The prayer-reading official knelt south-facing and read the prayer text.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer reader knelt facing south and read the prayer.

sentences.zh: 讀訖，俯伏興，舉祝官奠祝版於案，興。

translations.literal: When the reading was finished, he prostrated and rose; the prayer-holding official placed the prayer tablet on the desk and rose.
translations.idiomatic: When the reading was done he prostrated and rose; the prayer-holding official set the tablet on the desk and rose.

sentences.zh: 初獻再拜訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The initial offerer bowed twice; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The initial offerer bowed twice, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 降自北陛，詣太稷壇盥洗位，樂作，至位樂止。

translations.literal: He descended by the north steps and proceeded to the hand-washing station at the Great Altar of Grain; music began; when he reached his station the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He descended the north steps to the hand-washing station at the Grain altar; music played until he reached his station, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 盥洗升獻並如太社后土之儀。

translations.literal: Hand-washing, ascent, and libation—all by the same rite as at the Great Altar of Soil and the Spirit of Earth.
translations.idiomatic: Washing, ascent, and libation followed the same rite as at the Soil altar and Spirit of Earth.

sentences.zh: 降自北陛，樂作，復位，樂止。

translations.literal: He descended by the north steps; music began; when he returned to his station the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He descended the north steps, returned to station as music played, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 讀祝、舉祝官亦降復位。

translations.literal: The prayer-reading and prayer-holding officials likewise descended and returned to their stations.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer reader and prayer holder likewise descended and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 亞獻詣兩壇盥洗升獻，並如初獻之儀。

translations.literal: The secondary offerer proceeded to both altars for hand-washing, ascent, and libation—all by the same rite as the initial offerer.
translations.idiomatic: The secondary offerer went to both altars to wash, ascend, and offer libations by the same rite as the initial offerer.

sentences.zh: 終獻盥洗升獻，並如亞獻之儀。

translations.literal: The final offerer's hand-washing, ascent, and libation—all by the same rite as the secondary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: The final offerer washed, ascended, and offered libations by the same rite as the secondary offerer.

sentences.zh: 終獻奠獻畢，降復位，樂止，執事者亦復位。

translations.literal: When the final offerer's presentation was finished, he descended and returned to his station; the music stopped; attendants also returned to their stations.
translations.idiomatic: When the final offerer's presentation was done he descended and returned to station; the music ceased, and attendants returned to their stations.

sentences.zh: 太祝各進徹籩豆，樂作，卒徹樂止。

translations.literal: Each grand invoker advanced to remove the bian and dou; music began; when removal was complete the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Grand invokers removed the bian and dou as music played; when all were cleared the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 奉禮曰「賜胙，眾官再拜」。

translations.literal: The presentation official said, "Sacrificial meat is granted—all officials, bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The presentation official called, "Sacrificial meat is granted—all officials, bow twice."

sentences.zh: 贊者承傳，在位者皆再拜訖，送神樂作，一成止。

translations.literal: Announcers passed the word; all in station bowed twice; music for sending off the spirits began—one section—and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers relayed the command; all in station bowed twice; music for sending off the spirits played one section and ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮直官進初獻之左，曰「請詣望瘞位」，御史、博士從，樂作，至位北向立，樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual usher advanced to the left of the initial offerer and said, "Please proceed to the overlooking burial station"; censors and erudites followed; music began; when he reached his station he stood north-facing; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: A ritual usher stepped to the initial offerer's left and said, "Please proceed to the burial station"; censors and erudites followed; music played until he stood facing north at his station, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 初在位官將拜，諸太祝各執篚進於神座前，取瘞玉及幣，齋郎以俎載牲體並黍稷爵酒，各由其陛降，置於坎訖，贊者曰「可瘞」，東西各二人置土半坎。

translations.literal: As the officials in station were about to bow, each grand invoker with basket advanced before the spirit seat, took the burial jade and silks; acolytes with zuo bore the sacrificial flesh together with millet, panicled millet, cups, and wine; each descended by his steps, set them in the pit; when finished an announcer said, "It may be buried"; two men each on east and west placed earth filling half the pit.
translations.idiomatic: As officials were about to bow, grand invokers advanced with baskets and took the burial jade and silks; acolytes with zuo bore sacrificial flesh, millet, cups, and wine; each descended his steps and set them in the pit; an announcer called, "It may be buried," and two men on east and west each filled half the pit with earth.

sentences.zh: 禮直官進初獻之左，曰「禮畢」，禮直官各引獻官以次出。

translations.literal: The ritual usher advanced to the left of the initial offerer and said, "The rite is complete"; ritual ushers each led the offering officials out in order.
translations.idiomatic: A ritual usher stepped to the initial offerer's left and announced, "The rite is complete"; ushers then led the offering officials out in turn.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引監祭、太祝以下執事官，俱復於壇北墉下，南向立定。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the supervising sacrifice official, grand invokers, and all attendant officials below them, all returning below the north wall of the altar, standing south-facing in place.
translations.idiomatic: Ushers led the supervising sacrifice official, grand invokers, and all attendants back below the north wall of the altar, where they stood facing south.

sentences.zh: 奉禮曰「再拜」，監祭以下皆再拜訖，出。

translations.literal: The presentation official said, "Bow twice"; the supervising sacrifice official and all below bowed twice and departed.
translations.idiomatic: The presentation official called, "Bow twice"; supervising officials and all below bowed twice and departed.

sentences.zh: 祝史、齋郎及工人以次出。

translations.literal: Prayer clerks, acolytes, and craftsmen departed in order.
translations.idiomatic: Prayer clerks, acolytes, and craftsmen departed in turn.

sentences.zh: 祝版燔於齋所。

translations.literal: The prayer tablet was burned at the abstinence quarters.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer tablet was burned at the abstinence quarters.

sentences.zh: 光祿卿、監祭、監禮展視酒胙訖，乃退。

translations.literal: The Director of Imperial Entertainments, supervising sacrifice, and supervising ritual officials inspected and viewed the wine and sacrificial meat; when finished they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Imperial Entertainments and supervising sacrifice and ritual officials inspected the wine and sacrificial meat, then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 其告祭儀，告前三日，三獻官以下諸執事官，各具公服，赴中書省受誓戒。

translations.literal: As for the report-sacrifice rite: three days before the report, the three offering officials and all attendant officials below them each donned formal court dress and went to the Secretariat to receive the oath of abstinence.
translations.idiomatic: For the report sacrifice: three days beforehand, the three offering officials and all attendants donned formal dress and went to the Secretariat to receive the oath of abstinence.

sentences.zh: 告前一日，省牲器。

translations.literal: One day before the report, victims and vessels were inspected.
translations.idiomatic: One day before the report, victims and vessels were inspected.

sentences.zh: 告日質明，三獻官以下諸執事各服其服，禮直官引監祭、監禮以下諸執事官入自北墉下，南向立定。

translations.literal: On the report day at dawn, the three offering officials and all attendants below each donned proper dress; the ritual usher led the supervising sacrifice and ritual officials and all attendants below them in through below the north wall, standing south-facing in place.
translations.idiomatic: On the report day at dawn, offering officials and attendants donned proper dress; ushers led supervising officials and all attendants in below the north wall to stand facing south.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎贊曰「再拜」。

translations.literal: The presentation official announced, "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The presentation official called, "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 在位官皆再拜訖，奉禮郎贊曰「各就位」，「立定」。

translations.literal: All officials in station bowed twice; the presentation official announced, "Each to your station," "Stand in place."
translations.idiomatic: All in station bowed twice; the presentation official called, "Each to your station," then "Stand at ease."

sentences.zh: 監祭、監禮視陳設畢，復位立定。

translations.literal: The supervising sacrifice and supervising ritual officials inspected the arrangements; when finished they returned to their stations and stood in place.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising sacrifice and ritual officials inspected the arrangements, then returned to station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引三獻、司徒、太常卿、光祿卿入就位，立定。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the three offering officials, the Minister of Education, the Director of Imperial Sacrifices, and the Director of Imperial Entertainments in to take their stations and stand in place.
translations.idiomatic: Ushers led the three offering officials, Minister of Education, and directors of Imperial Sacrifices and Entertainments to their stations.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊「有司謹具，請行事」。

translations.literal: The ritual usher announced, "The responsible offices have reverently prepared everything—please perform the rite."
translations.idiomatic: An usher announced, "All is prepared—begin the rite."

sentences.zh: 降神樂作，八成止。

translations.literal: Music for descending the spirits began—eight sections—and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Music for descending the spirits played through eight sections and ceased.

sentences.zh: 太常卿瘞血，復位立定。

translations.literal: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices buried the blood, returned to his station, and stood in place.
translations.idiomatic: The Director of Imperial Sacrifices buried the blood and returned to stand at his station.

sentences.zh: 奉禮郎贊「再拜」。

translations.literal: The presentation official announced, "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The presentation official called, "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 皆再拜訖，禮直官引初獻官詣盥洗位，盥手訖，詣社壇正位神座前南向，搢笏跪，三上香，奠玉幣，執笏俯伏興。

translations.literal: When all had bowed twice, the ritual usher led the initial offering official to the hand-washing station; when hand-washing was finished he proceeded before the principal spirit seat at the Soil altar, south-facing; he inserted his tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, presented jades and silks, took up his tablet, prostrated, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: After all bowed twice, an usher led the initial offerer to wash his hands, then before the principal spirit seat at the Soil altar; facing south he knelt, offered incense three times and presented jades and silks, then prostrated and rose.

sentences.zh: 再拜訖，詣配位神座前西向，搢笏跪，三上香，奠幣，執笏俯伏興。

translations.literal: When he had bowed twice, he proceeded before the associated seat's spirit seat, west-facing; he inserted his tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, presented silks, took up his tablet, prostrated, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: After bowing twice he came before the associated spirit seat facing west, knelt, offered incense three times and presented silks, then prostrated and rose.

sentences.zh: 再拜訖，詣稷壇盥洗位，盥手訖，升壇，並如上儀。

translations.literal: When he had bowed twice, he proceeded to the hand-washing station at the Grain altar; when hand-washing was finished he ascended the altar—all by the rite above.
translations.idiomatic: After bowing twice he went to the hand-washing station at the Grain altar; after washing he ascended by the same rite as above.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When all was finished, he descended and returned to his station.
translations.idiomatic: When all was done he descended and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 司徒率齋郎進饌，奠訖，降復位。

translations.literal: The Minister of Education led acolytes to advance the food offerings; when presentation was finished they descended and returned to their stations.
translations.idiomatic: The Minister of Education led acolytes to present the food offerings, then descended and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻官詣盥洗位，盥手訖，詣爵洗位，洗爵訖，詣酒尊所酌酒訖，詣社壇神位座前，南向立，搢笏跪，三上香，執爵，三祭酒於茅苴，爵授執事者，執笏俯伏興。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the initial offering official to the hand-washing station; when hand-washing was finished he proceeded to the cup-washing station; when the cup was washed he proceeded to the wine-vessel station to pour wine; when pouring was finished he proceeded before the spirit seat at the Soil altar, stood south-facing, inserted his tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, took the cup, poured libation three times on the thatch bundle, handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, prostrated, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: An usher led the initial offerer to wash his hands and cup, pour wine at the wine station, then before the Soil altar's spirit seat; facing south he knelt, offered incense three times, poured libation three times on the thatch, handed back the cup, and prostrated and rose.

sentences.zh: 俟讀祝官讀祝文訖，再拜興，詣酒尊所酌酒訖，詣配位神座前，西向，搢笏跪，三上香，執爵，三祭酒於茅苴，爵授執事者，執笏俯伏興。

translations.literal: Awaiting the prayer reader to finish reading the prayer text, he bowed twice and rose; he proceeded to the wine-vessel station and poured wine; when finished he proceeded before the associated spirit seat, west-facing; he inserted his tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, took the cup, poured libation three times on the thatch bundle, handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, prostrated, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: When the prayer reader had finished he bowed twice and rose, poured wine at the wine station, then came before the associated spirit seat facing west; kneeling he offered incense three times, poured libation three times on the thatch, handed back the cup, and prostrated and rose.

sentences.zh: 俟讀祝文訖，再拜興，詣稷壇盥洗位，盥手，洗爵，酌獻，並如上儀。

translations.literal: Awaiting the prayer text to be read to the end, he bowed twice and rose; he proceeded to the hand-washing station at the Grain altar, washed his hands, washed the cup, poured and presented—all by the rite above.
translations.idiomatic: When the prayer reading was done he bowed twice and rose, went to the Grain altar to wash his hands and cup and pour the libation by the same rite as above.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When all was finished, he descended and returned to his station.
translations.idiomatic: When all was done he descended and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引亞獻，並如初獻之儀，惟不讀祝。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the secondary offerer—all by the same rite as the initial offerer, except no prayer was read.
translations.idiomatic: An usher led the secondary offerer through the same rite as the initial offerer, but without reading the prayer.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When all was finished, he descended and returned to his station.
translations.idiomatic: When all was done he descended and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引終獻，並如亞獻之儀。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the final offerer—all by the same rite as the secondary offerer.
translations.idiomatic: An usher led the final offerer through the same rite as the secondary offerer.

sentences.zh: 俱畢，降復位。

translations.literal: When all was finished, he descended and returned to his station.
translations.idiomatic: When all was done he descended and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 太祝徹籩豆訖，奉禮郎贊「賜胙」。

translations.literal: When the grand invokers had removed the bian and dou, the presentation official announced, "Sacrificial meat is granted."
translations.idiomatic: When grand invokers had cleared the bian and dou, the presentation official called, "Sacrificial meat is granted."

sentences.zh: 眾官再拜訖，禮直官引三獻、司徒、太常卿詣瘞坎位，南向立定。

translations.literal: When all officials had bowed twice, the ritual usher led the three offering officials, the Minister of Education, and the Director of Imperial Sacrifices to the burial pit, standing south-facing in place.
translations.idiomatic: After all officials bowed twice, ushers led the three offering officials, Minister of Education, and Director of Imperial Sacrifices to the burial pit to stand facing south.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊「可瘞」，禮畢出。

translations.literal: The ritual usher announced, "It may be buried"; when the rite was finished they departed.
translations.idiomatic: An usher called, "It may be buried," and when the rite was complete they departed.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引監祭、監禮、太祝、齋郎至北墉下，南向立定。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the supervising sacrifice and ritual officials, grand invokers, and acolytes to below the north wall, standing south-facing in place.
translations.idiomatic: Ushers led supervising officials, grand invokers, and acolytes below the north wall to stand facing south.

sentences.zh: 奉禮贊「再拜」，皆再拜訖，出。

translations.literal: The presentation official announced, "Bow twice"; all bowed twice and departed.
translations.idiomatic: The presentation official called, "Bow twice"; all bowed twice and departed.

sentences.zh: 先農之祀，始自至元九年二月，命祭先農如祭社之儀。

translations.literal: Sacrifice to the First Farmer began in the second month of the ninth year of Zhiyuan, when an order was issued that sacrifice to the First Farmer follow the rite for sacrificing to the Soil altar.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifice to the First Farmer began in the second month of the ninth year of the Zhiyuan era (1272), when an edict ordered that it follow the rite for the Soil altar sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月戊辰，祀先農東郊。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the second month of the fourteenth year, sacrifice was made to the First Farmer at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the second month of the fourteenth year (1277), the First Farmer was sacrificed to at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 十五年二月戊午，祀先農，以蒙古胄子代耕籍田。

translations.literal: On the wuwu day of the second month of the fifteenth year, sacrifice was made to the First Farmer; sons of Mongol nobles took the place of the plowing at the registered fields.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the second month of the fifteenth year (1278), the First Farmer was sacrificed to; sons of Mongol nobility performed the ceremonial plowing of the registered fields in lieu of the emperor.

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月丁亥，又命翰林學士承旨撒裏蠻祀先農於籍田。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the second month of the twenty-first year, an order was again issued for Academician-Expositor Sariman of the Hanlin Academy to sacrifice to the First Farmer at the registered fields.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the second month of the twenty-first year (1284), Academician-Expositor Sariman of the Hanlin Academy was again commanded to sacrifice to the First Farmer at the registered fields.

sentences.zh: 武宗至大三年夏四月，從大司農請，建農、蠶二壇。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the third year of Zhida of Emperor Wuzong, following the request of the Grand Director of Agriculture, two altars were built for Agriculture and Sericulture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the third year of the Zhida era (1310), at the request of the Grand Director of Agriculture, altars for Agriculture and Sericulture were built.

sentences.zh: 博士議：二壇之式與社稷同，縱廣一十步，高五尺，四出陛，外壝相去二十五步，每方有欞星門。

translations.literal: Erudites deliberated: the form of the two altars was the same as for Soil and Grain—a length and breadth of ten paces, five feet high, with steps on four sides; the outer enclosures stood twenty-five paces apart, each side having a star-pattern gate.
translations.idiomatic: Erudites ruled that the two altars should match those of Soil and Grain—ten paces square and five feet high, with steps on four sides; outer enclosures twenty-five paces apart, each with a star-pattern gate.

sentences.zh: 今先農、先蠶壇位在籍田內，若立外壝，恐妨千畝，其外壝勿築。

translations.literal: Now the altars of the First Farmer and First Silkworm were located within the registered fields; if outer enclosures were built, they might obstruct the thousand-acre fields—therefore the outer enclosures should not be built.
translations.idiomatic: Since the First Farmer and First Silkworm altars lay within the registered fields, building outer enclosures might obstruct the thousand-acre plots—so the enclosures were not to be built.

sentences.zh: 是歲命祀先農如社稷，禮樂用登歌，日用仲春上丁，後或用上辛或甲日。

translations.literal: That year an order was issued to sacrifice to the First Farmer as to Soil and Grain; ritual music used the ascending song; the day was fixed as the first ding day of mid-spring, though later sometimes the first xin day or a jia day was used.
translations.idiomatic: That year sacrifice to the First Farmer was ordered to follow the Soil and Grain rite, with ascending song for the music; the day was set as the first ding day of mid-spring, though later the first xin day or a jia day was sometimes used.

sentences.zh: 祝文曰：「維某年月日，皇帝敬遣某官，昭告於帝神農氏。」

translations.literal: The prayer text read: "On such-and-such year, month, and day, the Emperor reverently dispatched such-and-such an official to announce to Imperial Farmer Shennong."
translations.idiomatic: The prayer read: "On [date], the Emperor reverently dispatched [official] to announce to Imperial Farmer Shennong."

sentences.zh: 配神曰「於後稷氏」。

translations.literal: The associated spirit read: "To Lord Houji."
translations.idiomatic: The associated spirit read: "To Lord Houji."

sentences.zh: 祀前一日未後，禮直官引三獻、監祭禮以下省牲饌如常儀。

translations.literal: On the day before the sacrifice, after the wei hour, the ritual usher led the three offering officials, the supervising sacrifice and ritual officials, and all below to inspect the victims and food offerings according to the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The day before sacrifice, after the wei hour, a ritual usher led the three offering officials, supervising sacrifice and ritual officials, and all attendants to inspect victims and offerings by the usual rite.

sentences.zh: 祀日醜前五刻，有司陳燈燭，設祝幣，大官令帥其屬入實籩豆尊罍。

translations.literal: On the sacrifice day, five quarters before the chou hour, the responsible offices displayed lamps and candles, set out prayer silks, and the Director of the Imperial Kitchen led his subordinates to fill the bian, dou, wine vessels, and libation jars.
translations.idiomatic: On the morning of sacrifice, five quarters before the chou hour, officers set out lamps and candles and prayer silks; the kitchen director and staff filled platters, stands, wine vessels, and libation jars.

sentences.zh: 醜正，禮直官引先班入就位，立定，次引監祭禮按視壇之上下，糾察不如儀者。

translations.literal: At the chou hour proper, the ritual usher led the advance rank in to take their stations and stand in place; next he led the supervising sacrifice and ritual officials to inspect above and below the altar and to discipline those not conforming to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: At the chou hour the ritual usher led the advance ranks to station; then supervising sacrifice and ritual officials inspected the altar and corrected any lapses in protocol.

sentences.zh: 畢，退復位，東向立。

translations.literal: When finished, they withdrew and returned to their stations, standing east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: When done they withdrew and stood facing east at their stations.

sentences.zh: 奉禮曰「再拜」。

translations.literal: The presentation official said, "Bow twice."
translations.idiomatic: The presentation official called, "Bow twice."

sentences.zh: 贊者承傳再拜訖，奉禮又贊「諸執事者各就位」。

translations.literal: Announcers passed the word; when all had bowed twice, the presentation official again announced, "All ritual attendants, each to your station."
translations.idiomatic: Announcers relayed the command; after all bowed twice, the presentation official called again, "All attendants, to your stations."

sentences.zh: 禮直官各引執事官各就位，立定。

translations.literal: Ritual ushers each led the attendant officials each to his station; they stood in place.
translations.idiomatic: Ushers led each attendant official to his station where they stood at ease.

sentences.zh: 次引三獻官並與祭等官以次入就位，西向立。

translations.literal: Next the three offering officials together with sacrifice-participating officials and the like were led in order to take their stations, standing west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Next ushers led the three offering officials and participating officials to their stations, standing facing west.

sentences.zh: 禮直官於獻官之右，贊「請行事」，樂作三成止。

translations.literal: The ritual usher, to the right of the offering officials, announced, "Please perform the rite"; music began in three sections and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: A ritual usher at the offering officials' right called, "Begin the rite"; music played three sections and ceased.

sentences.zh: 奉禮贊「再拜」，在位者皆再拜。

translations.literal: The presentation official announced, "Bow twice," and all in station bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The presentation official called, "Bow twice," and all in station bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 太祝跪取幣於篚，立於尊所。

translations.literal: The grand invoker knelt, took silks from the basket, and stood at the wine-vessel station.
translations.idiomatic: The grand invoker knelt, took silks from the basket, and stood at the wine station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻官詣盥洗位，北向立，盥手帨手畢，升自東階，詣神位前北向立，搢笏跪，三上香，受幣奠幣，執笏俯伏興，少退，再拜訖，降復位，立定。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the initial offering official to the hand-washing station; standing north-facing he washed and dried his hands; when finished he ascended by the east steps, proceeded before the spirit seat, stood north-facing, inserted his tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, received the silks and presented them, took up his tablet, prostrated and rose, withdrew slightly, bowed twice, descended and returned to his station, and stood in place.
translations.idiomatic: An usher led the initial offerer to wash and dry his hands, then up the east steps before the spirit seat; facing north he knelt, offered incense three times and presented silks, prostrated and rose, withdrew slightly, bowed twice, descended, and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 大官令率齋郎設饌於神位前畢，俯伏興，退復位。

translations.literal: The Director of the Imperial Kitchen led acolytes to set out food offerings before the spirit seat; when finished he prostrated and rose, withdrew and returned to his station.
translations.idiomatic: The kitchen director led acolytes to set offerings before the spirit seat, then prostrated, rose, and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引初獻再詣盥洗位，北向立，盥手、帨手，詣爵洗位，洗爵拭爵，詣酒尊所酌酒畢，詣正位神位前，北向立。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led the initial offerer again to the hand-washing station; standing north-facing he washed and dried his hands; he proceeded to the cup-washing station, washed and wiped the cup; he proceeded to the wine-vessel station and poured wine; when finished he proceeded before the principal spirit seat, standing north-facing.
translations.idiomatic: The usher led the initial offerer to wash his hands and cup, pour wine at the wine station, then before the principal spirit seat facing north.

sentences.zh: 帨笏跪，三上香，三祭酒於沙池，爵授執事者，執笏俯伏興，北向立。

translations.literal: He dried his hands and inserted his tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, poured libation three times in the sand basin, handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, prostrated and rose, standing north-facing.
translations.idiomatic: He dried his hands, knelt with tablet in hand, offered incense three times, poured libation three times into the sand basin, handed back the cup, prostrated and rose, and stood facing north.

sentences.zh: 俟讀祝畢，再拜興。

translations.literal: Awaiting the prayer reading to finish, he bowed twice and rose.
translations.idiomatic: When the prayer had been read he bowed twice and rose.

sentences.zh: 次詣配位酒尊所，酌酒訖，詣神位前，東向立。

translations.literal: Next he proceeded to the associated seat's wine-vessel station, poured wine, and when finished proceeded before the spirit seat, standing east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Next he went to the associated seat's wine station, poured wine, then came before the spirit seat facing east.

sentences.zh: 搢笏跪，三上香，三祭酒於沙池，爵授執事者，執笏俯伏興，東向立。

translations.literal: He inserted his tablet and knelt, offered incense three times, poured libation three times in the sand basin, handed the cup to an attendant, took up his tablet, prostrated and rose, standing east-facing.
translations.idiomatic: He knelt with tablet in hand, offered incense three times, poured libation three times into the sand basin, handed back the cup, prostrated and rose, and stood facing east.

sentences.zh: 俟讀祝畢，再拜，退復位。

translations.literal: Awaiting the prayer reading to finish, he bowed twice, withdrew and returned to his station.
translations.idiomatic: When the prayer was done he bowed twice, withdrew, and returned to station.

sentences.zh: 次引亞終獻行禮，並如初獻之儀，惟不讀祝，退復位，立定。

translations.literal: Next the secondary and final offerers were led to perform the rite, all by the same rite as the initial offerer, except no prayer was read; they withdrew and returned to their stations and stood in place.
translations.idiomatic: The secondary and final offerers followed the initial offerer's rite without reading the prayer, then withdrew to their stations.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊徹籩豆，樂作，卒徹，樂止。

translations.literal: The ritual usher announced withdrawal of the bian and dou; music began; when withdrawal was complete the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: An usher called for the platters and stands to be cleared; music played until clearance was complete, then ceased.

sentences.zh: 奉禮贊賜胙，眾官再拜。

translations.literal: The presentation official announced bestowal of sacrificial meat; all officials bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The presentation official announced distribution of sacrificial meat; all officials bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 贊者承傳，在位者皆再拜訖，樂作送神之曲，一成止。

translations.literal: Announcers passed the word; when all in station had bowed twice, music for sending off the spirits began—one section—and stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Announcers relayed the command; after all bowed twice, music for sending off the spirits played one section and ceased.

sentences.zh: 禮直官引齋郎升自東階，太祝跪取幣祝，齋郎捧俎載牲體及籩豆簠簋，各由其階至坎位，北向立。

translations.literal: The ritual usher led acolytes up by the east steps; the grand invoker knelt and took the prayer silks and prayer tablet; acolytes with zuo bore sacrificial flesh together with bian, dou, fu, and gui; each by his steps descended to the pit station, standing north-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Ushers led acolytes up the east steps; the grand invoker knelt and took prayer silks and the prayer tablet; acolytes bore sacrificial flesh, platters, stands, and grain vessels down their respective steps to the burial pit, standing north.

sentences.zh: 俟三獻畢，至立定。

translations.literal: They awaited the three offerings to be finished, arrived, and stood in place.
translations.idiomatic: They waited until the three offerings were complete, then stood in place at the pit.

sentences.zh: 各跪奠訖，執笏俛伏興。

translations.literal: Each knelt and presented; when finished they took up their tablets, prostrated, and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Each knelt to present; when done they prostrated and rose.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊「可瘞」，乃瘞。

translations.literal: The ritual usher announced, "It may be buried," and they buried the offerings.
translations.idiomatic: An usher called, "It may be buried," and the offerings were buried.

sentences.zh: 焚瘞畢，三獻以次詣耕地所，耕訖而退。

translations.literal: When burning and burial were finished, the three offering officials in order proceeded to the plowing station, plowed, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: After burning and burial, the three offering officials in turn went to the plowing ground, performed the ceremonial plowing, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 此其儀也。

translations.literal: Such was the rite.
translations.idiomatic: Such was the rite.

sentences.zh: 先蠶之祀未聞。

translations.literal: Regarding sacrifice to the First Silkworm, nothing has been recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Nothing is recorded regarding the First Silkworm sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 其祝幣之式，祝版三，各一尺二寸，廣八寸，木用楸梓柏，文曰：「維年月日，皇帝敬遣某官等，致祭於大成至聖文宣王。」

translations.literal: As for the form of prayer silks: three prayer tablets, each one foot two inches long and eight inches wide, of catalpa, zelkova, and cypress wood; the text read: "On such-and-such year, month, and day, the Emperor reverently dispatched such-and-such officials to offer sacrifice to the Great Completion Ultimate Sage Literary Propagation King."
translations.idiomatic: Prayer silks were set thus: three prayer tablets, each one foot two inches by eight inches, of catalpa, zelkova, or cypress; the text read: "On [date], the Emperor reverently dispatched [officials] to sacrifice to the Great Completion Ultimate Sage Literary Propagation King."

sentences.zh: 於先師曰：「維年月日，某官等致祭於某國公。」

translations.literal: To the Former Teacher it read: "On such-and-such year, month, and day, such-and-such officials offer sacrifice to the Duke of such-and-such State."
translations.idiomatic: To the Former Teacher: "On [date], [officials] sacrifice to the Duke of [State]."

sentences.zh: 幣三，用絹，各長一丈八尺。

translations.literal: Three silks, of silk fabric, each one rod eight feet long.
translations.idiomatic: Three silks of fabric, each one rod and eight feet long.

sentences.zh: 其牲齊器皿之數，牲用牛一、羊五、豕五。

translations.literal: As for the numbers of victims, fermented offerings, and vessels: victims were one ox, five sheep, and five pigs.
translations.idiomatic: Victims and vessels: one ox, five sheep, and five pigs.

sentences.zh: 以犧尊實泛齊，象尊實醴齊，皆三，有上尊，加冪有勺，設堂上。

translations.literal: The sacrificial vessel was filled with fan qi, the elephant vessel with li qi—three each—with top vessels, covers and ladles added, set in the hall above.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels held fan qi and elephant vessels held li qi—three of each—with top vessels, covers, and ladles, set on the upper hall.

sentences.zh: 太尊實泛齊，山罍實醴齊，有上尊。

translations.literal: The grand vessel was filled with fan qi, the mountain jar with li qi, with top vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Grand vessels held fan qi and mountain jars held li qi, each with a top vessel.

sentences.zh: 著尊實盎齊，犧尊實醴齊，象尊實沈齊，壺尊實三酒，皆有上尊，設堂下。

translations.literal: The standing vessel was filled with ang qi, the sacrificial vessel with li qi, the elephant vessel with chen qi, and the pot vessel with the three wines—all with top vessels—set below the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Standing vessels held ang qi, sacrificial vessels li qi, elephant vessels chen qi, and pot vessels the three wines—all with top vessels—set below the hall.

sentences.zh: 盥洗位，在阼階之東。

translations.literal: The hand-washing station was east of the eastern steps.
translations.idiomatic: The hand-washing station stood east of the eastern steps.

sentences.zh: 以象尊實醴齊，有上尊，加冪有勺，設於兩廡近北。

translations.literal: The elephant vessel was filled with li qi, with a top vessel, cover and ladle added, set near the north of the two side halls.
translations.idiomatic: An elephant vessel holding li qi, with top vessel, cover, and ladle, was set near the north end of the two side halls.

sentences.zh: 盥洗位，在階下近南。

translations.literal: The hand-washing station was near the south below the steps.
translations.idiomatic: The hand-washing station stood near the south at the foot of the steps.

sentences.zh: 籩十，豆十，簠二，簋二，登三，铏三，俎三，有毛血豆，正配位同。

translations.literal: Ten bian, ten dou, two fu, two gui, three deng, three xing, three zuo, with a hair-and-blood dou—the principal and associated seats alike.
translations.idiomatic: Ten platters, ten stands, two fu, two gui, three deng, three xing, three zuo, and a hair-and-blood dou—for principal and associated seats alike.

sentences.zh: 籩豆皆二，簋一，簠一，俎一，從祀皆同。

translations.literal: Bian and dou two each, one gui, one fu, one zuo—alike for all associated worship.
translations.idiomatic: Two platters and two stands, one gui, one fu, and one zuo—for all associated worship alike.

sentences.zh: 凡銅之器六百八十有一，宣和爵坫一，豆二百四十有八，簠簋各一百一十有五，登六，犧尊、象尊各六，山尊二，壺尊六，著尊、太尊各二，罍二，洗二。

translations.literal: In all, bronze vessels numbered six hundred eighty-one: one Xuanhe libation-cup stand, two hundred forty-eight dou, one hundred fifteen fu and gui each, six deng, six sacrificial vessels and six elephant vessels each, two mountain vessels, six pot vessels, two standing vessels and two grand vessels each, two jars, and two basins.
translations.idiomatic: Bronze vessels totaled 681: one Xuanhe cup stand, 248 dou, 115 fu and 115 gui, 6 deng, 6 sacrificial and 6 elephant vessels, 2 mountain vessels, 6 pot vessels, 2 standing and 2 grand vessels, 2 jars, and 2 basins.

sentences.zh: 龍杓二十有七，坫二十有八，爵一百一十有八。

translations.literal: Twenty-seven dragon ladles, twenty-eight stands, and one hundred eighteen libation cups.
translations.idiomatic: 27 dragon ladles, 28 stands, and 118 libation cups.

sentences.zh: 竹木之器三百八十有四，籩二百四十有八，篚三，俎百三十有三。

translations.literal: Bamboo and wooden vessels numbered three hundred eighty-four: two hundred forty-eight bian, three baskets, and one hundred thirty-three zuo.
translations.idiomatic: Wooden and bamboo vessels totaled 384: 248 platters, 3 baskets, and 133 zuo.

sentences.zh: 陶器三，瓶二，香爐一。

translations.literal: Three pottery vessels: two bottles and one incense burner.
translations.idiomatic: Pottery: two bottles and one incense burner.

sentences.zh: 籩巾二百四十有八，簠簋巾二百四十有八，俎巾百三十有三，黃巾蒙單十。

translations.literal: Two hundred forty-eight bian covers, two hundred forty-eight fu and gui covers, one hundred thirty-three zuo covers, and ten yellow cloth covers.
translations.idiomatic: 248 platter covers, 248 fu and gui covers, 133 zuo covers, and 10 yellow cloth drapes.

sentences.zh: 其樂登歌。

translations.literal: The music used ascending song.
translations.idiomatic: Music was ascending song.

sentences.zh: 其日用春秋二仲月上丁，有故改用中丁。

translations.literal: The day used the first ding day of the second months of spring and autumn; if there were hindrances the middle ding day was used instead.
translations.idiomatic: The rite fell on the first ding day of mid-spring and mid-autumn; if circumstances prevented this, the middle ding day was used.

sentences.zh: 其釋奠之儀，省牲前期一日晡時，三獻官、監祭官各具公服，詣省牲所阼階，東西向立，以北為上。

translations.literal: As for the libation rite: one day beforehand, at the shen hour, the three offering officials and supervising sacrifice officials each donned formal court dress, proceeded to the eastern steps of the victim-inspection station, standing east- and west-facing, with the north as superior.
translations.idiomatic: For the libation rite: the day before, at the shen hour, the three offering officials and supervising sacrifice officials donned court dress and stood east and west at the eastern steps of the victim-inspection station, senior men to the north.

sentences.zh: 少頃，引贊者引三獻官、監祭官巡牲一匝，北向立，以西為上。

translations.literal: After a short while, usher-announcers led the three offering officials and supervising sacrifice officials to circuit the victims once, standing north-facing, with the west as superior.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward, usher-announcers led offering and supervising officials once around the victims to stand facing north, senior men to the west.

sentences.zh: 俟禮牲者折身曰「充」，贊者曰「告充」畢，禮牲者又折身曰「腯」，贊者曰「告腯」畢，贊者復引三獻官、監祭官詣神廚，視滌溉畢，還齋所，釋服。

translations.literal: They awaited the victim officer to bow and say "Full," whereupon the announcer said "Announcing fullness"; the victim officer again bowed and said "Plump," and the announcer said "Announcing plumpness"; when finished the announcer again led the three offering officials and supervising sacrifice officials to the spirit kitchen, viewed the washing and rinsing; when finished they returned to the abstinence quarters and changed out of dress.
translations.idiomatic: When the victim officer bowed and declared the animals 'full,' announcers relayed 'Fullness declared'; when he bowed again and declared them 'plump,' announcers relayed 'Plumpness declared'; usher-announcers then led officials to inspect washing at the spirit kitchen before returning to the abstinence quarters to change.

sentences.zh: 釋奠，是日醜前五刻，初獻官及兩廡分奠官二員，各具公服於幕次，諸執事者具儒服，先於神門外西序東向立，以北為上。

translations.literal: For the libation, on that day five quarters before the chou hour, the initial offering official and the two wing distribution officials, two men in all, each donned formal court dress at the tent station; all ritual attendants donned scholar dress and first stood east-facing in the western file outside the spirit gate, with the north as superior.
translations.idiomatic: On libation day, five quarters before the chou hour, the initial offerer and two wing distribution officials donned court dress at the tent station; attendants in scholar dress stood east-facing in the western file outside the spirit gate, senior men to the north.

sentences.zh: 明贊、承傳贊先詣殿庭前再拜畢，明贊升露階東南隅西向立，承傳贊立於神門階東南隅西向立。

translations.literal: The lead announcer and relay announcer first proceeded to before the hall court and bowed twice; when finished the lead announcer ascended the dew steps to the southeast corner and stood west-facing; the relay announcer stood at the southeast corner of the spirit gate steps, west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: Lead and relay announcers bowed twice before the hall court; the lead announcer then took the dew steps to the southeast corner and stood facing west, the relay announcer at the southeast corner of the spirit gate steps, also facing west.

sentences.zh: 掌儀先引諸執事者各司其事，引贊者引初獻官、兩廡分奠官點視陳設。

translations.literal: The protocol officer first led all ritual attendants each to his task; usher-announcers led the initial offering official and the two wing distribution officials to inspect the arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer set attendants to their tasks; usher-announcers led the initial offerer and wing distribution officials to inspect the arrangements.

sentences.zh: 引贊者進前曰「請點視陳設」。

translations.literal: The usher-announcer advanced and said, "Please inspect the arrangements."
translations.idiomatic: An usher-announcer stepped forward and called, "Please inspect the arrangements."

sentences.zh: 至階，曰「升階」，至殿檐下，曰「詣大成至聖文宣王神位前」，至位，曰「北向立」。

translations.literal: At the steps he said, "Ascend the steps"; reaching below the hall eaves he said, "Proceed before the spirit seat of the Great Completion Ultimate Sage Literary Propagation King"; at the station he said, "Stand north-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At the steps: "Ascend"; below the eaves: "Proceed before the Great Completion Ultimate Sage's spirit seat"; at station: "Stand facing north."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「詣兗國公神位前」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Proceed before the spirit seat of the Duke of Yan State."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Proceed before the Duke of Yan's spirit seat."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「東向立」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Stand east-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Stand facing east."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「詣鄒國公神位前」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Proceed before the spirit seat of the Duke of Zou State."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Proceed before the Duke of Zou's spirit seat."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「西向立」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Stand west-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Stand facing west."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「詣東從祀神位前」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Proceed before the eastern associated-worship spirit seats."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Proceed before the eastern associated-worship seats."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「東向立」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Stand east-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Stand facing east."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「詣西從祀神位前」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Proceed before the western associated-worship spirit seats."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Proceed before the western associated-worship seats."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「西向立」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Stand west-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Stand facing west."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「詣酒尊所」，曰「西向立」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Proceed to the wine-vessel station," and said, "Stand west-facing."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Proceed to the wine station"—"Stand facing west."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「詣三獻爵洗位」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Proceed to the three-offering cup-washing station."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Proceed to the three-offering cup-washing station."

sentences.zh: 至階，曰「降階」，至位，曰「北向立」。

translations.literal: At the steps he said, "Descend the steps"; at the station he said, "Stand north-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At the steps: "Descend"; at station: "Stand facing north."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「詣三獻官盥洗位」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Proceed to the three-offering hand-washing station."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Proceed to the three-offering hand-washing station."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「北向立」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Stand north-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Stand facing north."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「請就次」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Please to your stations."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Please to your stations."

sentences.zh: 方初獻點視時，引贊二人各引東西廡分奠官曰「請詣

translations.literal: While the initial offering official was inspecting the arrangements, two usher-announcers each led the east and west wing distribution officials, saying, "Please proceed to the
translations.idiomatic: While the initial offerer inspected, two usher-announcers each led the east and west wing distribution officials, saying, "Please proceed to the

translations.literal: (east or west)
translations.idiomatic: (east or west)

sentences.zh: 廡神位前」，至位

translations.literal: spirit seat before the wing]," arriving at station
translations.idiomatic: spirit seat before the wing]," and take station

sentences.zh: 〈（東曰東，西曰西）〉

translations.literal: (the east wing stands east, the west wing stands west)
translations.idiomatic: (east wing faces east, west wing faces west)

sentences.zh: 向立。

translations.literal: Stand facing [the designated direction].
translations.idiomatic: Stand facing the proper direction.

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「詣先儒神位前」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Proceed before the Former Confucian spirit seats."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Proceed before the Former Confucian spirit seats."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「南向立」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Stand south-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Stand facing south."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「退詣酒尊所」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Withdraw to the wine-vessel station."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Withdraw to the wine station."

sentences.zh: 至酒尊所，東西向立。

translations.literal: At the wine-vessel station they stood east- and west-facing.
translations.idiomatic: At the wine station they stood east and west.

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「退詣分奠官爵洗位」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Withdraw to the distribution-official cup-washing station."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Withdraw to the distribution officials' cup-washing station."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「南向立」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Stand south-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Stand facing south."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「請就次」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Please to your stations."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Please to your stations."

sentences.zh: 西廡分奠官點視畢，引贊曰「請詣望瘞位」。

translations.literal: When the west wing distribution official had finished inspecting, the usher-announcer said, "Please proceed to the overlooking burial station."
translations.idiomatic: When the west wing distribution official finished inspecting, an usher-announcer called, "Please proceed to the burial station."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「北向立」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Stand north-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Stand facing north."

sentences.zh: 點視畢，曰「請就次」。

translations.literal: When inspection was finished he said, "Please to your stations."
translations.idiomatic: When done: "Please to your stations."

sentences.zh: 初獻官釋公服，司鐘者擊鐘，初獻以下各服其服，齊班於幕次。

translations.literal: The initial offering official changed out of formal dress; the bell-striker struck the bell; from the initial offerer down each donned his proper dress and formed ranks at the tent station.
translations.idiomatic: The initial offerer changed out of court dress; the bell was struck; from the initial offerer down all donned proper dress and formed ranks at the tent station.

sentences.zh: 掌儀點視班齊，詣明贊報知，引禮者引監祭官、監禮官就位。

translations.literal: The protocol officer inspected the ranks until aligned, went to inform the lead announcer, and ritual ushers led the supervising sacrifice and ritual officials to their stations.
translations.idiomatic: The protocol officer confirmed ranks were aligned, notified the lead announcer, and ritual ushers led supervising sacrifice and ritual officials to station.

sentences.zh: 進前曰「請就位」。

translations.literal: Advancing forward he said, "Please take your stations."
translations.idiomatic: Stepping forward he called, "Please take your stations."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「就位，西向立。」

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Take your stations, stand west-facing."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Take your stations, stand facing west.

sentences.zh: 明贊唱曰「典樂官以樂工進，就位」，承傳贊曰「典樂官以樂工進，就位」。

translations.literal: The lead announcer intoned, "The music director brings the musicians in to take their stations," and the relay announcer said, "The music director brings the musicians in to take their stations."
translations.idiomatic: The lead announcer intoned, "Music director, bring the musicians to station," and the relay announcer repeated it.

sentences.zh: 明贊唱曰「諸執事者就位」，承傳贊曰「諸執事者就位」。

translations.literal: The lead announcer intoned, "All ritual attendants, to your stations," and the relay announcer said, "All ritual attendants, to your stations."
translations.idiomatic: The lead announcer called, "All attendants, to your stations," and the relay announcer repeated it.

sentences.zh: 明贊唱曰「諸生就位」，承傳贊曰「諸生就位」，引班者引諸生就位。

translations.literal: The lead announcer intoned, "All students, to your stations," and the relay announcer said, "All students, to your stations"; the rank usher led the students to their stations.
translations.idiomatic: The lead announcer called, "All students, to your stations," relay announcers repeated it, and rank ushers led students to station.

sentences.zh: 明贊唱曰「陪位官就位」。

translations.literal: The lead announcer intoned, "Attending officials, to your stations."
translations.idiomatic: The lead announcer called, "Attending officials, to your stations."

sentences.zh: 承傳贊曰「陪位官就位」，引班者引陪位官就位。

translations.literal: The relay announcer said, "Attending officials, to your stations," and the rank usher led the attending officials to their stations.
translations.idiomatic: The relay announcer repeated the call, and rank ushers led attending officials to station.

sentences.zh: 明贊唱曰「獻官就位」，承傳贊曰「獻官就位」，引贊者進前曰「請就位」，至位，曰「西向立」。

translations.literal: The lead announcer intoned, "Offering officials, to your stations," and the relay announcer said, "Offering officials, to your stations"; the usher-announcer advanced and said, "Please take your stations"; at the station he said, "Stand west-facing."
translations.idiomatic: The lead and relay announcers called offering officials to station; an usher-announcer stepped forward with "Please to your stations," then at station, "Stand facing west."

sentences.zh: 明贊唱曰「辟戶」，俟戶辟，迎神之曲九奏。

translations.literal: The lead announcer intoned, "Open the doors"; they awaited the doors to open, and the hymn for receiving the spirits was performed in nine sections.
translations.idiomatic: The lead announcer called, "Open the doors"; when they opened, the hymn receiving the spirits was played in nine sections.

sentences.zh: 樂止，明贊唱曰「初獻官以下皆再拜」，承傳贊曰「鞠躬，拜，興，拜，興，平身」。

translations.literal: The music stopped; the lead announcer intoned, "All from the initial offering official down, bow twice," and the relay announcer said, "Bow from the waist, bow, rise, bow, rise, stand at ease."
translations.idiomatic: The music ceased; the lead announcer called for all below the initial offerer to bow twice, and the relay announcer guided the bows: "Bow from the waist, bow, rise, bow, rise, stand at ease."

sentences.zh: 明贊唱曰「諸執事者各司其事」。

translations.literal: The lead announcer intoned, "All ritual attendants, each to his task."
translations.idiomatic: The lead announcer called, "All attendants, each to his task."

sentences.zh: 俟執事者立定，明贊唱曰「初獻官奠幣」。

translations.literal: When the attendants had taken their stations, the lead announcer intoned, "Initial offering official, present silks."
translations.idiomatic: Once attendants stood firm, the lead announcer called, "Initial offerer, present the silks."

sentences.zh: 引贊者進前曰「請詣盥洗位」。

translations.literal: The usher-announcer advanced and said, "Please proceed to the hand-washing station."
translations.idiomatic: An usher-announcer stepped forward: "Please proceed to the hand-washing station."

sentences.zh: 盥洗之樂作，至位，曰「北向立」。

translations.literal: Music for hand-washing began; at the station he said, "Stand north-facing."
translations.idiomatic: Hand-washing music began; at station: "Stand facing north."

sentences.zh: 搢笏，盥手，帨手，出笏，樂止。

translations.literal: He inserted his tablet, washed his hands, dried them, and withdrew his tablet; the music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: He washed and dried his hands, withdrew his tablet, and the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 及階，曰「升階」。

translations.literal: Reaching the steps, he said, "Ascend the steps."
translations.idiomatic: At the steps: "Ascend."

sentences.zh: 升殿之樂作。

translations.literal: Music for ascending the hall began.
translations.idiomatic: Music for ascending the hall began.

sentences.zh: 樂止，入門，曰「詣大成至聖文宣王神位前」。

translations.literal: The music stopped; entering the gate he said, "Proceed before the spirit seat of the Great Completion Ultimate Sage Literary Propagation King."
translations.idiomatic: The music ceased; entering the gate he called, "Proceed before the Great Completion Ultimate Sage's spirit seat."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「就位，北向立，稍前」。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Take your station, stand north-facing, step slightly forward."
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Take your place, stand facing north, step slightly forward."

sentences.zh: 奠幣之樂作。

translations.literal: Music for presenting silks began.
translations.idiomatic: Music for presenting silks began.

sentences.zh: 搢笏跪，三上香，奉幣者以幣授初獻，初獻受幣奠訖，出笏就拜興，平身少退，再拜，鞠躬，拜興，拜興，平身。

translations.literal: He inserted his tablet and knelt, thrice offered incense; the silk-bearer handed silks to the initial offerer; the initial offerer received the silks and presented them; when finished he withdrew his tablet, prostrated, bowed, and rose, stood at ease and withdrew slightly, bowed again, bowed from the waist, bowed and rose, bowed and rose, and stood at ease.
translations.idiomatic: He knelt with tablet in hand and thrice offered incense; a silk-bearer handed silks to the initial offerer, who received and presented them; he withdrew his tablet, prostrated and rose, stood at ease, withdrew slightly, bowed again, bowed from the waist twice, and stood at ease.

sentences.zh: 曰「詣兖國公神位前」。

translations.literal: He said, "Proceed before the spirit seat of the Duke of Yan State."
translations.idiomatic: He called, "Proceed before the Duke of Yan's spirit seat."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「就位，東向立」，奠幣如上儀。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Take your station, stand east-facing"; he presented silks by the same rite as above.
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Take your place, stand facing east"; he presented silks as before.

sentences.zh: 曰「詣鄒國公神位前」。

translations.literal: He said, "Proceed before the spirit seat of the Duke of Zou State."
translations.idiomatic: He called, "Proceed before the Duke of Zou's spirit seat."

sentences.zh: 至位，曰「就位，西向立」，奠幣如上儀。

translations.literal: At the station he said, "Take your station, stand west-facing"; he presented silks by the same rite as above.
translations.idiomatic: At station: "Take your place, stand facing west"; he presented silks as before.
